title: Claims Adjudication and Cost Shares under the TRICARE Premium-Based Plans
content:
**Claims note - TRICARE Premium-Based Plans.**

## Pricing a claim line

Claims under a premium-based plan are priced with the plan's own cost-share keys. The cost-share key is the sponsor's entry group - Group A for entry before 2018-01-01, Group B on or after - followed, for TRICARE Reserve Select and TRICARE Young Adult, by the pay-grade band of the sponsor (E-1 to E-4, or E-5 and above) and, for TRICARE Retired Reserve, by "retiree".

- The deductible, family catastrophic cap and outpatient percentages are the values the tier's cost-share schedule gives for that key.
- For a Group B key, network outpatient care carries the fixed network copayments of the TRICARE Select tier of the same group and band (the TRICARE Select Retiree Group B tier for the Group B retiree key).
- Deductibles and caps are calendar-year family accumulators of the service date, and premiums never count toward them:
  - the deductible met is, per beneficiary, the deductible applied on the year's adjudicated lines less the deductible withdrawn by their reversals, in the calendar plan year containing the service date of the line being adjudicated;
  - the catastrophic total is, across the premium-plan enrollments of the purchaser's family (the same sponsor), the liability on the year's adjudicated lines less the liability withdrawn by their reversals, in the same calendar plan year.
- Once the family reaches its cap, the line carries no liability.

## Plan features applied to claims

TRICARE Young Adult Prime and TRICARE Reserve Select members in a Prime Service Area receive PCM services only where the tier assigns a PCM, and point-of-service charges apply only where the tier's point-of-service option applies. TRICARE pays after other health insurance.

## Reversals

A reversal withdraws exactly one adjudicated line's deductible and liability, at most once. The line being reversed has not already been reversed - read from the plan's claim lines: no earlier reversal names that line.

| Adjudicated line | Already reversed | Reversal may be posted |
|---|---|---|
| line 1 of a claim | no | yes, withdrawing that line's deductible and liability |
| line 1 of a claim | yes | no |

## Example (hypothetical)

A TRICARE Reserve Select purchaser whose sponsor entered service in 2016 at pay grade E-6 is priced under the Group A, E-5 and above key; a sponsor who entered in March 2019 at E-3 is priced under Group B, E-1 to E-4.
